spec.model: one pooled Ridge alpha=10, type offsets, no tuning
spec.y: corrected engine net(final) minus net(if closed at +24h), no funding
spec.target_clip: none: preserve complete positive and negative tail
spec.transform: train-only median imputation and StandardScaler; no feature clipping
spec.train: Binance entry2018-22 with exit strictly before2023-01-01; +24h strictly before base exit
spec.test: Binance entry>=2023-01-01; immutable fixed historical split, not historical real-time forecasts
spec.exit_rule: predicted future increment < 0, fixed zero threshold
spec.event_order: standing add counts iff add_t<=landmark_time, then close at known hour-close
spec.price_coverage: exact clock landmark; require continuous entry-to-landmark hourly OHLC and continuous 24h feature window
spec.path: entry hour excluded; only completed hours ending before/at landmark included
spec.effect: one-off static exit overlay, not replacement state-machine replay; early exit can allow new entries
spec.interpretation: chronological retrospective diagnostic on already researched history, not causal nor independent forward proof
spec.execution: same-close execution after observing close retained from engine; may be optimistic
spec.funding: excluded, to be supplied in a later separate correction
